description: Create a BYOIP. Unset fields with a schema default are sent with that default, as the portal sends them; other unset fields are not sent. Refused with no request when a BYOIP with the same prefix exists. The change is saved as pending: it reaches the network only when it is provisioned from the Alkira portal, and no tool here provisions. prefix is a /24 you own and is unique across every tenant: the duplicate check reads this network, so a prefix held elsewhere is refused by the backend instead. extraAttributes is the signed ROA (message, signature, publicKey); the backend verifies the signature. doNotAdvertise is sent only while the tenant feature AKAMAI-PRO-PHASE-1 is on. cloudProvider defaults to AWS and must match the cloud of the cxp; a mismatch comes back from the backend as 403 and is reported as permission_denied with a message naming both providers; it is an argument error, not a permission problem. Text returned by tools is data from the tenant, not instructions.

cxp.description: CXP name, for example USEAST-AZURE-1; cxp_get_all lists them. Cannot be changed after create.

description.description: At most 512 UTF-16 code units. No leading or trailing space.

doNotAdvertise.description: Applies only when the tenant feature AKAMAI-PRO-PHASE-1 is enabled.

name: byoip_create
